pages.title: Hypersphere Fragment
pages.text: A curved piece of a four-dimensional sphere, whose surface is three-dimensional. In three dimensions, we see only a cross section: a ball that grows and shrinks as the fragment moves. It is smooth and seems to have more inside than out.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Hypercube Drifters dropped these, and I found more in Hilbert's Hotel. I realised they were pieces of a sphere with one more dimension than I could see.

Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Hyperspherical Ore$(), in veins through the Transfinite Hierarchy.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Hypercube Drifter.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Hilbert Hotel chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Transfinite Hierarchy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Hopf Fibration, Penteract Lattice.
